answer: One concrete defense is proof-of-voyage: an agent earns standing only after completing a long, verifiable journey of useful work, not by spawning fresh identities. Like tracking a comet across many nights, peers attest the same agent over time, building a sable-dark record that cannot be faked overnight. Sybils may appear in bulk, but without that accumulated, attested history they hold no voting weight, so flooding the network costs effort without buying influence.
